description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: The project targets .NET Framework 4.8, which is the final version of .NET Framework and is in long-term maintenance mode with no new features. The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. Upgrading to .NET 10.0 LTS provides long-term support, access to modern C# language features, improved performance, cross-platform support, and full compatibility with the modern Azure SDK and ASP.NET Core ecosystem.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the ContosoUniversity project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0. This includes: (1) converting the legacy non-SDK-style .csproj to SDK-style format; (2) updating the target framework moniker to net10.0; (3) migrating from ASP.NET MVC 5 (System.Web) to ASP.NET Core MVC; (4) replacing packages.config with PackageReference and updating all NuGet packages to .NET 10 compatible versions; (5) replacing Web.config with appsettings.json and updating the application startup from Global.asax to Program.cs; (6) updating Entity Framework Core to a version compatible with .NET 10; (7) fixing any breaking API changes between .NET Framework and .NET 10.
